items.title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
items.summary: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

items.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
items.summary: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

items.title: HSBC rolls out its first HKD stablecoin RedCoin to retail users
items.summary: PayMe users will be able to activate a stablecoin wallet in-app in the coming days for peer-to-peer and peer-to-merchant payments.

items.title: Malaysia and Thailand Join Singapore’s BLOOM Digital-Money Initiative
items.summary: The expanded participant group includes Visa, Mastercard and the World Bank Group, with work focused on cross-border settlement frameworks and interoperability.
